title: Report Timing Adjustment to Calibration Goodwill, Workmanship Warranties
content:
**Rule.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the calibration goodwill sum on a Calibration Workmanship Warranty, with everything added into it, is adjusted for how promptly the most recent calibration-fault report followed the discovery date the customer gave:

| Calendar days from the discovery date to the most recent calibration-fault report | Calibration goodwill sum |
|---|---|
| within the prompt-report days, 3 days or fewer | multiplied by the prompt multiplier of 1.5 and rounded up to the whole dollar |
| later than 3 days but within the timely-report days, 10 days or fewer | multiplied by the timely multiplier of 1.2 and rounded to the cent |
| later than the timely-report days, more than 10 days | stays as figured |

The adjustment acts on the calibration goodwill sum before it is limited to the plan's goodwill authority per charge.

## Inputs

- **Discovery date:** the date the customer gave as first noticing the fault, on the most recent calibration-fault concern report on the coverage.
- **Report date:** the date of that same report.
- **Lag:** the calendar days from the discovery date to the report date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Lag | Treatment |
|---|---|
| 3 days | prompt: multiplied by 1.5, rounded up to the whole dollar |
| 4 days | timely: multiplied by 1.2, rounded to the cent |
| 10 days | timely |
| 11 days | stays as figured |

## Worked figures (hypothetical calibration goodwill sum of USD 9.20)

- Lag 2 days: USD 9.20 multiplied by 1.5 is USD 13.80, rounded up to the whole dollar, USD 14.00.
- Lag 7 days: USD 9.20 multiplied by 1.2 is USD 11.04.
- Lag 15 days: USD 9.20.
